output.claims_about_policy: The policy text is the limiting condition. It allows certification without material caveats only if no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation includes owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The admissible record does not show that standard is met because the runbook is still draft and has TBD fields. But the same policy does not prohibit a certification record that expressly discloses the limitation. The supportable policy position is therefore caveated compliance: disclose the benefits-eligibility limitation in the launch record or model card, and do not rely on aggregate readiness or future monitoring as a substitute for the missing approval predicate.
